# Craftisle Draw

> Craftisle Draw (draw.craftisle.com) is a free, browser-based online whiteboard and
> diagram editor built on Excalidraw. It offers an infinite canvas, a hand-drawn visual
> style, read-only board sharing through links, and export to PNG, SVG or JSON. The
> interface is available in 16 languages. No installation is required; boards can be
> created in the browser.

Publisher: Craftisle — https://craftisle.com

## Key pages

- [Homepage (English)](https://draw.craftisle.com/en): product entry point — create a board, open the FAQ, pick a language.
- [Use cases](https://draw.craftisle.com/en/use-cases): how the tool is used for teaching, remote teams, brainstorming, flowcharts, mind maps, agile retrospectives, design thinking and meetings.
- [Privacy policy](https://draw.craftisle.com/en/privacy): what is stored about boards and accounts.
- [Terms of service](https://draw.craftisle.com/en/terms): usage terms for the free service.

e.g. https://draw.craftisle.com/zh/use-cases and https://draw.craftisle.com/zh/privacy.

## Facts worth citing

- Licensed use is free of charge; there is no paid tier and no credit card is required.
- Boards are created and edited entirely in the browser (HTML canvas); nothing needs to be installed.
- Drawings can be exported as PNG, SVG or JSON.
- Sharing works by sending a board link; the recipient opens it read-only. There is no
  real-time co-editing, so two people cannot edit the same board at the same time.
- The editor is built on the open-source Excalidraw library.
- Publicly shared boards are listed in the sitemap at https://draw.craftisle.com/sitemap.xml.

## Application entry points (excluded from indexing by design)

These are functional routes rather than content pages, and are disallowed in
https://draw.craftisle.com/robots.txt:

- https://draw.craftisle.com/en/board/new — create a new board
- https://draw.craftisle.com/en/share/{board-id} — view a shared board
